roles.title: Machine Learning Engineer
bullets: Built a synthetic-data pipeline for complex, multi-system workflows, enabling rapid evaluation experiments, model regression analysis, and adversarial testing without production data; reduced issue diagnosis and resolution turnaround time by 70%.
Developed a production FastAPI service for automated complaints investigation using AI agents, integrating event-driven orchestration, execution tracking, persistence, and feedback APIs.

Built workflows using observability tools and evaluation frameworks to assess LLM and agent outputs, retrieval, tool use, and failure modes, supporting reliable iteration and regression investigation.
Prototyped LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, smolagents, and AutoGen; designed reusable routing, handoff, parallel, and evaluator-optimizer patterns and assessed production trade-offs.
Built MCP tools and integrations for knowledge retrieval, developer platforms, and custom services to support multi-step agent workflows.
Led cross-team delivery, owned technical design decisions, and communicated progress and outcomes to stakeholders and leadership.

Fine-tuned a language model using LoRA for COBOL code completion, infilling, and domain-specific question answering; evaluated task performance and integrated inference through AWS SageMaker endpoints into agent-assisted developer workflows.

roles.title: Software Developer
bullets: Developed a scalable Python framework and training scenarios for autonomous-vehicle simulation to support scenario-driven development and testing.
Optimised Python, GitLab CI, and Docker delivery pipelines to improve deployment efficiency and accelerate scenario updates.
Built Jenkins/Python automated testing frameworks that reduced manual testing effort and shortened test cycles.
Developed ML tooling and CI/CD workflows using NLP, PyTorch, and TensorFlow to support development and experimentation.
Created a Python/Linux diagnostic tool that reduced platform-specific issues and improved debugging reliability.

skills.Software engineering: Object-oriented programming, design patterns, FastAPI, REST APIs, event-driven architecture, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Pydantic, JWT/RBAC, distributed systems
skills.AI / LLM engineering: LLM applications, agentic AI, RAG, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, tool-using agents, synthetic data, evaluation and controls, adversarial evaluation, prompt-injection testing, MCP
skills.Agent frameworks: LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, PydanticAI, smolagents, AutoGen
skills.Tools and cloud: Linux, Docker, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Git, JIRA, Kibana, Grafana, Agile (Scrum), AWS Bedrock, AWS SageMaker
skills.Machine learning: NLP, Transformers, PyTorch, TensorFlow, fine-tuning, LoRA, model evaluation, SageMaker inference integration
skills.Evaluation and observability: LLM and agent evaluation, observability tools, evaluation frameworks, synthetic data, retrieval and tool-use evaluation, regression analysis, adversarial testing

summary: Applied AI Engineer with experience designing reliable AI systems, developing scalable Python services, and translating emerging machine learning capabilities into practical software solutions. Combines strong software engineering fundamentals with expertise in agentic AI, LLM applications, evaluation, and cloud-based deployment; experienced in cross-functional engineering and delivering solutions in complex environments.
